SELECT SUM(AccumulatedCurrentBalance) FROM 
        (SELECT A.ACID, A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE, B.ACID AS ACID_GAM, B.FORACID FROM busc.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES A
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 and isActive = 1) B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
        WHERE A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE = '2023-01-27') BUSC
    FULL OUTER JOIN
        (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId, PeriodEndDate, AccumulatedCurrentBalance
        FROM bnkm.CasaTdAggregateBalance
        WHERE AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance' AND PeriodEndDate = '2023-01-27') BNKM 
            ON BUSC.FORACID = BNKM.CustomerAccountId
    WHERE BUSC.FORACID IS NOT NULL
    ---(BUSC.FORACID IS NOTNULL OR BNKM.CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL OR BUSC.ACID IS NOT NULL) 
    BUSC.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL != BNKM.AccumulatedCurrentBalance

SELECT TOP 10 * FROM 
        (SELECT A.ACID, A.TRAN_DATE_BAL, A.EOD_DATE, A.END_EOD_DATE, B.ACID AS ACID_GAM, B.FORACID FROM busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE A
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 and isActive = 1) B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
        WHERE A.EOD_DATE <= '2023-01-27' AND A.END_EOD_DATE >= '2023-01-27') BUSC
    FULL OUTER JOIN
        (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartDate, BalanceAmount
        FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
        WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND PeriodStartDate <= '2023-01-27' AND PeriodEndDate >= '2023-01-27' AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') BNKM 
            ON BUSC.FORACID = BNKM.CustomerAccountId
    WHERE (BNKM.CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL AND BUSC.ACID IS NOT NULL) 
    AND BUSC.TRAN_DATE_BAL != BNKM.BalanceAmount
